section.sectionSummaryBrief: Explains why the concept of "and grant our portion in Your Torah" is discussed in this maamar about "a garden locked," connecting it to the state of marriage and the Tzemach Tzedek's interpretation.
section.t: And on a deeper level, we can say, by first prefacing the explanation in the maamar about the matter of "and grant our portion in Your Torah"
(which is the concept of marriage),
for seemingly,
behold, in this maamar he explains that "a garden locked" is the matter of "sanctify us with Your commandments,"
and what does it have to do here to explain the concept of "and grant our portion in Your Torah"?
And simply, we can say,
that this explanation here of the concept of "and grant our portion in Your Torah" is relevant to "a spring locked" that is in the continuation of the verse.
For it is brought in the Midrash33
"A garden locked" refers to virgins, "a spring locked" refers to married women,
and the Tzemach Tzedek explains34
that "a garden locked" is the aspect of betrothal and "a spring locked" is the aspect of marriage.
[And one can connect this with the Tzemach Tzedek's commentary35
that "a spring locked" is the concept of "unveil36
my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah,"
for the main matter of marriage will be in the future to come37,
because then there will be38
the revelation of the inner dimension of the Torah39].
But,
since in this maamar
(the continuation of "this Matzah")
it speaks only about the matter of "a garden locked"
(and the explanation of "a spring locked" begins in the maamar that follows it40),
it is logical to say,

that what is explained in this maamar, the concept of "and grant our portion in Your Torah," is because through this, additional explanation is added in understanding the concept of "a garden locked."
For this, that through the service of "a garden locked"
("sanctify us with Your commandments")
one comes to "and grant our portion in Your Torah,"
absorption into the innerness,
is,
because the drawing down of the commandments, through which the betrothal is made, is in a manner of "and I will place in them a living spirit"
(as above, section 4).
However, the revelation of this matter is in the marriage of "and grant our portion in Your Torah."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Describes the two services of "a garden locked" (mitzvos) and "a spring locked" (Torah study, especially its inner dimension), and that both must be done in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber," as per the birthday directive.
section.t: And this is "a garden locked... a spring locked...,"
that "a garden locked" is the service of fulfilling the commandments and "a spring locked" is the occupation with Torah, and particularly the inner dimension of Torah,
and both services need to be in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber," as per the directive of the Baal HaYom Huledes (the one whose birthday it is)41.
And likewise is the progression of "they go from strength to strength"42,
from the level of betrothal
("a garden locked")
to the level of marriage
("a spring locked"),
that the progression and ascent must be in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber."
And through an arousal from below, an arousal from above,
that also the drawing down and revelation from above, through these services, will be "lechat’chilah ariber,"
also in the value of the "lechat’chilah ariber" of man's service.
For in addition to this, that when the service is in a manner of "I have toiled,"
then "and I found"43,
that "finding" is not commensurate with the toil,
since a "finding" comes by way of absence of prior intent44,
the "finding" itself is in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Concludes with a prayer that through discussing and serving in these matters, we will merit the future redemption, which will bring the perfection of both mitzvos and Torah in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber" without any delay.
section.t: And may it be His will,
that through speaking about these matters,
and especially through the service in this,
we will merit, very soon, the future redemption,
when there will be the perfection of "sanctify us with Your commandments" and "grant our portion in Your Torah,"
the perfection of the commandments – "and there we will serve You as Your commandments of Your will"45,
and the perfection of the Torah – "a new Torah from Me will go forth"46,
and all this will be in a manner that it will not delay us even for the blink of an eye47,
and this itself is in a manner of "lechat’chilah ariber,"
that it will not delay us even for the blink of an eye, literally.
